newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - PNB seen as good buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - PNB seen as good buy.

text.p: Philippine Asia Equity Inc said on Monday that Philippine National Bank offered "a good buying opportunity for medium to long-term players".

The brokerage said PNB's sale of foreclosed assets next year could help beef up its loanable funds. It estimated that the bank could sell 400 million pesos worth of non-earning assets next year and another 400 million pesos worth the year after.
The brokerage has pegged strong support for PNB shares at 300 pesos, while resistance is seen between 340 to 350 pesos.
PNB lost 2.50 pesos on Monday to close at 317.50.
